function.name: get_order
function.description: Look up an order by its ID. Returns its status and total.

function.name: cancel_order
function.description: Cancel an order that has not shipped yet.

messages.content: You are the support agent for an online shop. Use the tools to look up and change orders; never guess an order's status. Only cancel an order whose status is "processing". Keep replies short.
Hi, can you cancel order ORD-777? I ordered the wrong colour.
Done: order ORD-777 was still processing, so I've cancelled it. You'll get a confirmation email shortly.
